issues.title: Code: accept native GitHub assignment as a claim
issues.body:
In MultiAgency/near-agencies, let the coordinator (lib/coordinator.mjs) treat a native GitHub assignment on a `ready` seat as a claim, alongside `/claim`.

Acceptance criteria:
- A `ready` seat whose assignee is on the roster and eligible (lib/seats.mjs `eligibility`) moves from `ready` to `in-progress`, with the same confirmation comment `/claim` gets (naming the payout account).
- If the assignee is not eligible, the coordinator removes the assignment and comments the reason, worded like a refused `/claim`.
- `/claim` keeps working exactly as today, and seats the coordinator itself assigned are unaffected.
- The decision logic is covered by new tests in test/ that need no network or credentials.
- The README's claiming section mentions that people with repository access can use GitHub's assign button.
- `npm run check` and `npm test` pass.

issues.title: Review: accept the native-claims pull request
issues.body: Review the pull request from the code seat against its acceptance criteria. Request changes in a comment, or approve and merge it on GitHub and post a handoff accepting the work.
